data.name: Merwyn
data.gender_notes: Merwyn is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Welsh elements 'mar' (sea) and 'gwen' (friend). The name Merwyn evokes images of a strong and loyal companion, someone who is deeply connected to the water and the natural world. The name Merwyn carries the meaning “Sea friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Merwyn usually hope their child will grow to embody sea friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of friendship and companionship in the spiritual realm.
data.etymology: Merwyn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sea friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Merwyn total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

It carries the weight of sea stories and the vastness of Welsh culture, inspiring a sense of mystery, adventure, and camaraderie. It is a name that resonates with those who cherish their heritage and journey towards a deeper understanding of themselves and their world.
data.spiritual_significance: Merwyn also holds spiritual meaning as it represents the deep connection between friends, the sea, and the natural world. In Christianity, this name can serve as a daily reminder of God's powerful presence in all things, including deep friendships and the wonders of His creation. Merwyn is a name for those seeking a spiritual companionship and a greater sense of purpose in their lives.
